# Pinned vector basemap assets

MapLibre GL JS 5.24.0 (BSD 3-Clause) and @maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet 0.1.3 (ISC), retrieved from the exact upstream package URLs recorded in sources.json. The original adapter is retained. The served adapter changes only its browser-global Leaflet namespace to ncsuVotingLeaflet, preserving the existing app and route layers. MapLibre GL JS license: https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js/blob/v5.24.0/LICENSE.txt ; adapter license: https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet/blob/main/LICENSE .

The style is https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron, the same style URL used in the housing-affordability source. Data attribution: OpenFreeMap, OpenMapTiles and OpenStreetMap contributors. Geometry calculations still use frozen NC State GIS, not this display basemap.
